name: casewave-monorepo
description: Modular Node-Link Graph Engine for React
author: mrkwxopya

scripts.check:all: npm run check:json && npm run check:names && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run build && npm run check:package-json && npm run check:scripts && npm run check:barrels && npm run check:markers && npm run check:security && npm run check:exports && npm run check:dist && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:treeshake && npm run check:consistency && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:api && npm run test:declarations && npm run smoke && npm run fixture && npm run test:migration && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:snapshot && npm run test:crash
scripts.test:local-consumer: npm install --prefix playground/local-consumer && npm run build --prefix playground/local-consumer
scripts.perf:all: npm run perf:large && npm run perf:memory
scripts.check:engineering: npm run check:all && npm run perf:all
scripts.alpha:ready: npm run check:alpha-freeze && npm run check:all
scripts.check:health: npm run check:package-json && npm run check:dist
scripts.test:clean-room: npm run build && npm install --prefix clean-room/consumer && npm run typecheck --prefix clean-room/consumer && npm run build --prefix clean-room/consumer
scripts.check:final-engineering: node scripts/check-final-engineering-gate.mjs && npm run check:all && npm run test:clean-room
scripts.docs:deploy: vitepress build docs && gh-pages -d docs/.vitepress/dist -r https://github.com/mrkwxopya/casewave.git
